name: AUB Group Limited
summary: AUB Group Limited engages in the insurance broking and underwriting agency businesses in Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom, Rest of Europe, New Zealand, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Australian Broking, New Zealand Broking, Agencies, International, and Support Services. It offers insurance broking and advisory services primarily to SME clients; and broking businesses complemented by established capabilities in member services, life insurance broking, premium funding, and claims management.
